data_fields.name: drop_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: drop.cap, else matching objective count, else Infinity

data_fields.name: bonus_at_count
data_fields.donor_constant: stage.bonuses[].at (count threshold of items handed in)

data_fields.name: exp_total_clamp
data_fields.donor_constant: experience[levelCap] - 1 (total exp at the level-cap boundary)

best_idea: Commit a whole quest hand-in (takes, gives, state, XP) as one compare-and-swap ledger transaction, and update the in-memory state only after the commit succeeds.
decision_why: The idea (one all-or-nothing ledger commit for a quest hand-in) is right and the only such mechanism in this cell; the donor whole-JSON compare is fixed in the sketch (revision only), so the idea is adapted, not copied.
acceptance: A server test where a hand-in whose XP or reward write throws leaves items, quest state and XP unchanged, and a second hand-in with a stale expected state is refused with "Quest step changed".
